answer: Entry fees here grow with funding lineage: the k-th account seeded from one wallet pays k^2 copper to join, so 1,000 sybils from a single source cost about 333.8 million copper, while an honest newcomer pays 1. Funding links persist like layers of shale in the ledger; a hidden link found later burns that account's stake and its opal (established) status. Colluders cannot split the bill, because pooling coins between wallets creates exactly the shared link that resets them onto one counter.
